research_method: Independent direct public primary documentation/web lookup and narrowly targeted upstream source/PR-file reads. No repository tree/history scan, local Git, downloaded code execution, candidate assistance or held-out input.

sources.context: §12.3 parsing/weights/ranking; §8.11 types; §65.4 pending entries and fuzzy limit
sources.observation: Configuration changes lexemes and phrase matching. Ranking is application-specific. GIN searches pending entries; cleanup affects latency. The optional fuzzy limit returns a random subset.

sources.version: 3.8 banner says no longer maintained; latest unpinned; hybrid 2.11, RRF 2.19, normalization 2.10
sources.context: Fusion definitions, score interpretation, required pipeline and BM25/vector example
sources.observation: RRF uses ranks, discards margins and is not a calibrated confidence threshold. Pipeline fusion is distinct from relevance validation and authorization.

sources.family: OpenSearch DLS / role composition / exact identity mapping
sources.version: 3.8 and latest documentation; introducing PR merged 2022-04-12 at 7e6b62cb7f54977be736c5efaa14e01579aa5324
sources.context: Read/write scope; Unicode mapping; adaptive TLQ; multiple roles; PR setting registration, PrivilegesEvaluator caller, ConfigModelV7 and DfmOverwritesAllTest
sources.observation: DLS rules OR; mixed no-DLS roles remain filtered unless the override is enabled. Historical implementation/tests establish false default for the introduced setting. Analyzer tokenization can conflate identifiers. This is not a revocation protocol.

sources.context: §4.2.4–4.2.5 quote/position normalization, ambiguity and restricted-content warning; §4.3–4.3.2 State before selectors
sources.observation: Quote matching may remain ambiguous and duplicates selected content. Offsets depend on normalized representation; State precedes selector processing. These locators provide neither retention nor authorization.

sources.context: Multiple role union, aggregate-information warning, conditional request-cache exclusions; node/segment cache eligibility
sources.observation: A no-query role can widen Elastic access; aggregate facts may remain observable. Request-cache exclusions are conditional. Node query caches differ from protected application snippets. These vendor-specific examples cannot be transferred as guarantees.

sources.version: pgvector v0.8.7; OpenSearch pinned historical license; Typesense v28.0; current Elastic FAQ
sources.context: License notices and Elastic ESRE feature eligibility
sources.observation: pgvector uses PostgreSQL license terms; OpenSearch code Apache 2.0; Typesense GPLv3. Elastic DLS/RRF feature eligibility depends on subscription/deployment. No package or model license is selected by either proposal.
sources.license_notices: No upstream code or corpus is copied into this evidence. Copyright and full license terms remain at the exact linked originals.

sources.context: Multiple actions / Multiple action results / must_exist
sources.observation: One atomic state update can include partial action success. The documented guard and per-action results matter when the intended remove/add set must succeed together.

sources.context: Scoped keys, server-side generation, parent revocation and search-only parent permissions
sources.observation: Embedded filters constrain requests; revoking a parent invalidates descendant keys. Correct indexed ACL data and protected parent credentials remain required; this is not source-permission freshness.

sources.family: Azure ACL enforcement / freshness / preview history
sources.version: Examples 2026-08-01-preview; November 2025 behavior change; push functionality preview
sources.context: Query filter construction, missing token/elevated read, 5xx failure, last-written ACL fields and preview limits
sources.observation: Enabled enforcement omits protected content without a user token and fails rather than returning partially filtered results on evaluation errors. Push ACLs stay stale until updated. Preview status and elevated read prevent blanket production-security claims.

sources.family: Graph version retrieval / retention and SharePoint purge
sources.context: Version id, authorized GET permissions, temporary download URL, finite history; purge/retention/hold FAQ
sources.observation: Version IDs do not assure retention. Temporary content URLs are unauthenticated and not immediately revoked. Expiry trimming differs from manual deletion/recycle-bin behavior and respects retention/hold conditions.

sources.family: Hybrid issue / fix / release / unshipped resolver
sources.context: Request-filter/query-phase callers, HybridQueryUtil validation, all three added unit-test paths; 3.8.0 release note; HLD body
sources.observation: The merged remedy rejects unsupported DFS hybrid requests; it does not implement that combination. The open resolver design is not a shipped feature. Test source was inspected, never run.

sources.context: Elastic RRF recommendation; OpenSearch query sets/judgments/configurations and exactly two Workbench clauses
sources.observation: Vendor recommendations do not establish this corpus's relevance. Workbench requires judgments and has a two-clause optimization scope; ordinary hybrid and its optimizer are distinct.

sources.version: Current public Git documentation; no local Git operations
sources.observation: A retained commit plus path selects its blob/tree. A moving reference or line number alone is not a durable document-edition locator.
